description: This file contains functions for resolving and applying outbound thread IDs and preparing outbound message routes in a messaging system, including handling session routes and threading context.

methods.name: resolveAndApplyOutboundThreadId
methods.description: Resolves a thread ID based on parameters and context, and applies it to action parameters if not already set.

methods.name: prepareOutboundMirrorRoute
methods.description: Prepares an outbound message route, resolving thread IDs, session routes, and updating action parameters accordingly.
